title: Late Charges Entering the Payoff of a Past-Due Invoice — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
**Clause.** When a creditor client pays off a past-due fee invoice of an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements, which of the invoice's late charges enter the payoff depends on how promptly the client settles:

1. where the payoff is made no more than 10 calendar days after the invoice's most recent late charge and the invoice carries 3 or fewer late charges, only that most recent late charge enters;
2. where the payoff is made no more than 10 calendar days after it and the invoice carries more than 3 late charges, only the late charges booked on the invoice in the 3 months before the payoff enter;
3. otherwise every late charge on the invoice enters.

The late charges that enter are the late-charge part of the payoff, added to the invoice's unpaid amount.

**Definitions.**

- *The invoice's late charges* are the late-charge entries in the agreement's client money history carrying that invoice's number; their count is how many the invoice carries.
- *Days after the most recent late charge* are counted in calendar days from the date of the invoice's latest late-charge entry to the day of the payoff, that date not counted and the payoff day counted.
- *The 3 months before the payoff.* A window of a number of months before a date covers the dates after the same day that number of months earlier, up to and including that date; here the window ends on the day of the payoff.

## Condition matrix

| Days since the most recent late charge | Late charges on the invoice | Late charges entering |
|---|---|---|
| 10 or fewer | 3 or fewer | the most recent one only |
| 10 or fewer | more than 3 | those booked in the 3 months before the payoff |
| more than 10 | any number | every late charge on the invoice |

## Hypothetical cases

Invoice with late charges of 24.75 USD on 2026-02-10, 25.40 USD on 2026-03-10, 26.10 USD on 2026-04-10, 26.80 USD on 2026-05-10 and 27.50 USD on 2026-06-10 — five late charges.

- Payoff on 2026-06-20, 10 days after the most recent charge; more than 3 charges, so those in the window after 2026-03-20 up to 2026-06-20 enter: 26.10 USD, 26.80 USD and 27.50 USD, which is 80.40 USD.
- Payoff on 2026-06-21, 11 days after: every charge enters, 130.55 USD.
- The same invoice carrying only the charges of 2026-04-10, 2026-05-10 and 2026-06-10, payoff on 2026-06-15: 3 charges, within 10 days, so only 27.50 USD enters.
